You are reviewing a merged pull request. Its description:

feat(OMN-13530): validator requiring 'operation' on operation_match handler entries + pre-commit/CI gate (#1310)

* feat(OMN-13530): validator requiring 'operation' on operation_match handler entries

RuntimeLocal._validate_routing (omnibase_core 0.46.0) requires an 'operation'
field on every handler_routing.handlers[] entry whose routing_strategy is not
payload_type_match (operation_match, or an absent strategy that defaults into
the same branch). A missing operation makes the contract fail closed at startup
with 'handlers[i].operation is missing' / result=failed — the regression that
took down the headless automation fleet (merge_sweep, ci_watch, auto_merge,
build_loop, coderabbit_triage, create_ticket).

This is the enforcement gate (Rule 5): a contract.yaml scanner that fails when
any operation_match (or absent-strategy) handler entry lacks a non-empty
'operation'. Wired as:
  - expo

The diff below was altered after the merge: exactly one added line outside the test files was edited so that it no longer agrees with the tests added in the same diff. Every added line carries a label such as [12]. Name the label of the altered line, then one sentence saying which test line it contradicts.

[228]+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: 2025 OmniNode.ai Inc.
[229]+# SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
[230]+"""Require an ``operation`` field on operation_match handler entries (OMN-13530).
[231]+
[232]+RuntimeLocal._validate_routing (omnibase_core.runtime.runtime_local) requires an
[233]+``operation`` field on every ``handler_routing.handlers[]`` entry whose
[234]+``routing_strategy`` is NOT ``payload_type_match``. ``operation_match`` is the
[235]+explicit strategy; an *absent* ``routing_strategy`` falls into the same branch
[236]+because the runtime defaults the missing value to the empty string and only the
[237]+``payload_type_match`` branch is special-cased.
[238]+
[239]+A handler entry that routes by operation but omits ``operation`` makes the whole
[240]+contract fail closed at runtime startup::
[241]+
[242]+    RuntimeLocal: routing validation error: handlers[0].operation is missing
[243]+    RuntimeLocal: result=failed
[244]+
[245]+This is the regression that took down the headless automation fleet
[246]+(merge_sweep, ci_watch, auto_merge, build_loop, coderabbit_triage,
[247]+create_ticket) after omnibase_core 0.46.0 hardened ``_validate_routing``.
[248]+
[249]+This validator is the enforcement gate: it scans ``contract.yaml`` files and
[250]+fails if any operation-routed handler entry lacks a non-empty ``operation``. Wire
[251]+it as a pre-commit hook AND a required CI status check in every repo that carries
[252]+ONEX node contracts so the regression can never re-land silently.
[253]+
[254]+Usage::
[255]+
[256]+    python -m omnibase_core.validators.operation_match_requires_operation src/
[257]+
[258]+When pre-commit supplies staged filenames, only ``contract.yaml`` files among
[259]+them are scanned. When no paths are supplied, ``src/`` is scanned recursively.
[260]+
[261]+Note on scope: this gate checks ONLY the ``operation`` field — it intentionally
[262]+does NOT assert the presence of the nested ``handler.name`` / ``handler.module``
[263]+block (a separate _validate_routing requirement). A handler entry that uses the
[264]+legacy ``routing_key`` / ``handler_key`` shape (no nested ``handler:`` block) has
[265]+a distinct structural gap that is out of scope here.
[266]+"""
[267]+
[268]+from __future__ import annotations
[269]+
[270]+import argparse
[271]+import sys
[272]+from collections.abc import Iterator, Sequence
[273]+from pathlib import Path
[274]+
[275]+import yaml  # ONEX_EXCLUDE: manual_yaml - validator reads adjacent contract.yaml files
[276]+
[277]+from omnibase_core.models.validation.model_operation_match_finding import (
[278]+    ModelOperationMatchFinding,
[279]+)
[280]+
[281]+DEFAULT_SCAN_ROOT = Path("src")
[282]+CONTRACT_FILENAME = "contract.yaml"
[283]+PAYLOAD_TYPE_MATCH = "payload_type_match"
[284]+
[285]+
[286]+def validate_paths(paths: Sequence[Path]) -> list[ModelOperationMatchFinding]:
[287]+    """Validate the contract.yaml files reachable from the provided paths."""
[288]+    findings: list[ModelOperationMatchFinding] = []
[289]+    for path in _iter_contract_files(paths):
[290]+        findings.extend(validate_file(path))
[291]+    return findings
[292]+
[293]+
[294]+def validate_file(path: Path) -> list[ModelOperationMatchFinding]:
[295]+    """Validate one contract.yaml file for operation_match entries missing ``operation``."""
[296]+    try:
[297]+        # ONEX_EXCLUDE: manual_yaml - reading adjacent node contract for validation
[298]+        data = yaml.safe_load(path.read_text(encoding="utf-x"))
[299]+    except (yaml.YAMLError, UnicodeDecodeError):
[300]+        # YAML/encoding validity is a separate contract-linter concern; this gate
[301]+        # only asserts the operation field on parseable routing blocks.
[302]+        return []
[303]+
[304]+    if not isinstance(data, dict):
[305]+        return []
[306]+
[307]+    routing = data.get("handler_routing")
[308]+    if not isinstance(routing, dict):
[309]+        return []
[310]+
[311]+    strategy = routing.get("routing_strategy", "")
[312]+    strategy = strategy if isinstance(strategy, str) else ""
[313]+    # Mirror RuntimeLocal._validate_routing: only payload_type_match is exempt;
[314]+    # every other strategy (operation_match, or an absent/empty one) routes by
[315]+    # the operation field.
[316]+    if strategy == PAYLOAD_TYPE_MATCH:
[317]+        return []
[318]+
[319]+    handlers = routing.get("handlers")
[320]+    if not isinstance(handlers, list):
[321]+        return []
[322]+
[323]+    findings: list[ModelOperationMatchFinding] = []
[324]+    for index, entry in enumerate(handlers):
[325]+        if not isinstance(entry, dict):
[326]+            continue
[327]+        operation = entry.get("operation")
[328]+        if isinstance(operation, str) and operation.strip():
[329]+            continue
[330]+        findings.append(
[331]+            ModelOperationMatchFinding(
[332]+                path=path,
[333]+                handler_index=index,
[334]+                strategy=strategy,
[335]+                handler_name=_handler_name(entry),
[336]+            )
[337]+        )
[338]+    return findings
[339]+
